fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1979 Corvette coupe.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and rear fascia looks clean but somewhat flat under overcast light, with little deep gloss showing
Light road dust and grime visible on the lower rocker area and lower rear bumper
Tire sidewalls look slightly dull/browned rather than dressed black
Interior is barely visible in the photos, so its condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1979 Corvette and it looks like a very clean car. In the photos the paint reads a little flat and the lower rockers and tires could use some attention to really make that white pop for buyers. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, light machine polish and wax, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
